title: Replacement strategies and temp staker deployed without pauser registration — emergency pause cannot reach the contracts that will custody all staker DOLA/USDC principal
description: The live system registers global Pauser 0x7c5A…85a3 on the original staker and on all three old strategies (verified on fork). The script deploys ysDolaV2, ysUsdcV2 and the tempStaker with pauser == address(0) and neither this script nor any story-060 sibling calls setPauser. Post-migration the V2 strategies custody the staker's entire DOLA/USDC principal but are outside emergency-pause coverage; the temp staker holds all bounced principal during the leg1->leg2 window with the same gap.
impact: Incident response degraded for the replacement contracts (owner can still act via Ownable functions, but the pauser pathway/automation does not cover them).

classification.assetImpact: No direct loss. V2 strategies and temp staker are deployed with pauser==address(0), so the global Pauser cannot reach the contracts that custody all staker DOLA/USDC principal post-migration (and the temp staker during the bounce window). Incident-response coverage gap.
attackPath: 1. Live system registers global Pauser on the original staker and all old strategies.
2. Script deploys ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2/tempStaker without setPauser; no sibling adds it.
3. Post-migration the V2 strategies (and temp during bounce) are outside emergency-pause coverage.
classification.likelihood: Low — only matters if an incident requires pausing; owner can still act via Ownable functions.
classification.assumptions: Non-obvious footgun: operator assumes the new contracts inherit the existing pause coverage.
classification.externalRequirements: An incident requiring the pauser pathway.

evidence: Fork reads: pauser()==0x7c5A…85a3 on original staker and both old strategies; pauser()==0x0 on ysDolaV2/ysUsdcV2/tempStaker post-run. grep: no setPauser in the 5 suite scripts. side-effects.json clusterChecks[3].
recommendation: Add setPauser(0x7c5A…85a3) for both V2 strategies (and optionally the temp staker for the bounce window) to step 1, mirroring the old strategies' config; assert it in a post-condition.
dedupNotes: Sole source: deploy F5 (idx4). Distinct root cause (MissingPauserRegistration). Standalone Low.
sanitizationReason: New entry point migrate:ys-swap-deploy. Missing pauser registration on V2 strategies + temp staker. Note ledger c294d931 (dev entry, StableStaker pauser==0) is the SAME pattern CLASS but a DIFFERENT entryPoint (dev) and different contracts (V2 strategies/temp staker), already fixed for the dev path -- per-entryPoint fingerprinting keeps this distinct; cross-reference only. Non-obvious footgun (incident-response gap), not obvious misconfig. NEW.
severityJustification: Non-obvious incident-response footgun (Law-3 in-scope): the replacement contracts custody all staker principal yet are deployed outside the emergency-pause coverage the rest of the system has, a gap the operator would be surprised by. No direct asset loss and owner can still act via Ownable controls, so Low with safe-config guidance to mirror the old strategies' pauser registration.
